**Chinese name:** 沐曦集成电路（上海）股份有限公司 (Mùxī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The 'second stock of domestic GPU' — STAR IPO 17 December 2025 raised ¥41.97亿 with a +693% first day and ¥330 billion initial cap, the peak moment of the GPU listing frenzy; FY2025 revenue ¥16.44亿 (+121%) still loss-making (-¥7.89亿), H1 2026 revenue ¥13.24亿 with headline net profit turned positive only on non-recurring items. Its C600 fully-domestic-chain closure is the flagship proof that AI chips can be built without TSMC.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Data-center GPGPU chips/cards, GPU IP, MetaXLink cluster interconnect, AI software stack.

| **Node Sophistication** | C500 N7-equivalent + HBM2e; C600 domestic advanced node + HBM; C700 targeting ~H100-level (per company statements relayed by 21经济, exact node undisclosed) |
